name: Dense techno
about: Style test E. Hyper-detailed city and machinery with hard cel shading, from the dense tech-city comic tradition, kept bright rather than dystopian. Described by its traits; no artist is named in the prompt.
prompt: Hyper-detailed science fiction comic art: precise fine linework, obsessive mechanical and architectural detail with cables, vents, panels and small machines, dense layered cityscapes, cel-shaded flat color with hard-edged shadows, cinematic wide-angle perspective, clean and bright rather than grim, no text, no lettering, no writing, no logos, no numbers.

settings.veridia: Clean stone and greenery woven through the machinery, cool greens and greys.
settings.dzego: Packed electronic streets, neon pink, cyan and yellow accents against dark blue.
settings.united-cities: Towering layered blocks, steel blue and amber.
